historical_references.reference: Amodh was a famous Hindu prince and poet of the 11th century, who is believed to have lived in the kingdom of Kannauj in present-day Uttar Pradesh, India. He is best known for his contribution to the Sanskrit poetic tradition through his works in the Bhakti genre, which focused on devotion to the Hindu deity Krishna.
